e3_critical_path_traces.method: --trace added to scripts_general/compress_family_general.py (trace mode skips emission/verification and never touches compression_summary.json). After the MTBDD build, walk the deepest root-to-leaf path: at each node follow the child with the deepest subtree, tie-break smallest branch value. Emit (step, feature_name, value_taken, rows_before, rows_after). Feature indices strictly increase along any path (children are built at bi+1), so each feature can appear AT MOST ONCE per path - this is a structural property of the ordered MTBDD.
e3_critical_path_traces.n4_regeneration_note: reproduces v1 mtbdd stats exactly (duel 652 nodes/depth 15, asym 2050/19, 4p 2183/21)

evidence: all 7 traces: depth == n_distinct_features; no feature is tested twice on any deepest path (and none can be: variable order is fixed, indices strictly increase along every path)

the AI's 'range-refinement chain' pattern (same feature retested at coarsening thresholds) does not exist in this evaluator family: the MTBDD branches are multi-way equality tests on each feature's exact value, not binary <= thresholds

depth growth +1/+3/+3/+5 (duel/asym/4p/full-vs-N4-deepest) is fully accounted for by distinct-feature growth: duel +1 (a_chk, dy_A join; e_R leaves), asym +3 (9 join, 6 leave - the path substantially re-routes), 4p +3 (5 join, 2 leave), full +5 over the N=4 deepest family (nW, nB, x_D_rel, d_APR, dy_D, d_KD_A2, d_KA_D2 join; dx_A2, dx_D2 leave)

the closest empirical analog to a 'chain' is the consecutive run of 4 DISTINCT second-pawn interaction features closing the N=5 full-space path (d_KA_A2, d_KD_A2, d_KA_D2, d_KD_D2), each tested exactly once

n6_prediction.assumption: depth(N=6) = depth(N=5) + (# features that become essential at N=6). The never-essential semantic pool is 15 d7 features (dy_p, e_p, dy_A2, dy_D2, blk_R_D2, blk_A2_Dp, blk_A2_D2, cap_A2, cap_D2, Rcap_D2, Dpcap_R, pass_R, pass_Dp, e_A2, e_D2) dominated by the second-pawn interaction block; assume 3-5 of them activate at N=6 (same mechanism that activated dy_p / d_ApR / nW / nB at N=5: more board room makes these structures discriminative). Each activation adds at most +1 test (structural, no repeats); path re-routes may also DROP features (asym joined 9 while dropping 6 at N=5), which bounds the growth from above. The tail (6 canonical coordinates) has never been essential at any N and is assumed to stay unused.
n6_prediction.contrast: the AI's chains model predicted ~31-32 for N=6; the numerically correct estimate under the observed mechanism is ~30 (29-31) - close by coincidence, wrong mechanism

e6_feature_symmetry.method: cheb/features5/features7 extracted from scripts_general/compress_family_general.py via AST and executed with N per board; 40k random canonical states per family per N; file-shift (+1) and rank-shift (+1) probes applied to square positions only (tau excluded; board-safe states only) plus a single-square move probe to detect non-spatial features

class_definitions.absolute_coordinate: changes under file translation (depends on absolute file; includes edge-folded e_* and the canonical tail)
class_definitions.rank_only: invariant under file translation, changes under rank translation (promotion-anchored race distances; also role-reassigned pure relations whose runner flips when ranks shift)
class_definitions.relative_distance: invariant under both file and rank translation

e6_feature_symmetry.note: tau/rwhite/nW/nB are non-spatial by construction and are classified 'other'; they are trivially translation-invariant, so ti_pct_spatial_only gives the invariance fraction over purely spatial features

basis_level.n_independent: counts identical at N=4 and N=5 (symmetry structure does not depend on board size)

absolute_coordinate_features.character: all are edge-folded file metrics min(f, N-1-f) (proximity to the vertical board edge) or canonical tail coordinates; no raw absolute square appears in the semantic basis

e6_feature_symmetry.survivor_trend: the fraction of translation-invariant features among MTBDD-USED features RISES from N=4 to N=5 (duel 81.0%->90.0%, asym 80.0%->82.4%, 4p 84.4%->87.5%, full 82.4%): the tuner progressively drops absolute-coordinate features (duel drops e_A, e_D at N=5)

verdict.rationale: >= 80% holds on both semantic bases under the spatial-only counting (81.8% duel, 87.0% d7) and exactly at the bar for d7-semantic under the strict relative+rank-only counting (80.0%); duel misses it strictly (75.0%) only because the two non-spatial role/tempo features (tau, rwhite) are excluded from the numerator there while being trivially translation-invariant. The only true violators are the edge-folded e_* metrics and the canonical tail - and the tail is never used by any built MTBDD. Compression does improve with N partly because the effective feature space is translation-invariant, and increasingly so: used-feature invariance grows with N.
